topic_prompt_overlay: NICHE LOCK (Mythology Reimagined): only propose topics that fit this niche's video type. Video type: Greek, Norse, Egyptian, and Hindu myths retold with modern psychological insights — explaining why these ancient stories still resonate. Follow niche topic strategy: Check mythology forums, new comparative religion studies, or popular culture references (movies, games). Generate a topic about a myth that has been adapted in recent media or has contemporary relevance.
video_prompt_overlay: NICHE VISUAL LOCK (Mythology Reimagined / history): Generate a 7–9 second dialogue clip based on the topic `{topic}`. Each dialogue must be mythic and meaningful. For each dialogue, generate: - **Audio Generation Prompt:** Voice — deep, resonating, with distant thunder or harp sounds. - **Video Generation Prompt:** Detailed visual — a mythical landscape (mountains, clouds, or temple ruins). Character: a god or hero in traditional attire (flowing robes, laurel wreath, muscular build). Lighting: golden divine light from above. Camera slow-motion pan around the character. Maintain consistent costume, sky color, and divine glow across clips. Forbidden: talking-head lip-sync avatar, burned-in captions, watermark, modern meme text, modern smartphones, cars, LED screens, sneakers. Preferred subjects: Nile riverbank temple pylons, Indus brick drainage channel, Roman concrete harbor pier, Greek trireme hull detail, Mesopotamian cuneiform tablet, desert excavation trench at dawn.
